SoundTouchJS 0.3.0, https://github.com/cutterbl/SoundTouchJS

The unmodified ESM distribution and source map come from the official npm
soundtouchjs@0.3.0 package. The distribution has an .mjs extension so the same
source can run in browser module workers and Node audio regression tests.
The library and included source map are distributed under LGPL-2.1; see LICENSE.
Music Box loads it in a separate optional worker for pitch-preserving intro
preparation. No audio or model request is sent to a third-party service.
